# Princeton Solutions Inc.

> Independent IT audit, GRC, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, third-party risk and AI governance for regulated organizations.

Princeton Solutions Inc. is an independent IT audit, governance, risk and compliance practice,
established in 2012 and based in Pennsylvania, USA. It assesses and advises;
it does not resell software or implementation services. Engagements are led by
credentialed senior practitioners and evidenced to the standard that regulators,
external auditors and boards expect.

Tagline: Trust through Governance.

## Services

- [AI Governance & Assurance](https://shinish.github.io/princeton-solutions-site/services/ai-governance-and-assurance) — Build and test the controls that make AI use defensible, from policy through model-level audit. Focus: ISO 42001 · AI RMF.
  - ISO/IEC 42001 readiness assessments and internal audits
  - NIST AI RMF adoption and maturity assessments
  - Trustworthy AI policy, charter and working-group design
  - AI inventory, risk tiering and audit programs for AI/ML systems
- [IT Audit & Internal Audit Support](https://shinish.github.io/princeton-solutions-site/services/it-audit-and-internal-audit-support) — Outsourced and co-sourced IT audit delivery across the full audit lifecycle. Focus: ITGC · IIA.
  - Risk-based IT audit strategy and multi-year audit plans
  - ITGC, application, IAM, data protection and IT asset management audits
  - Security operations, infrastructure and cloud audits
  - Audit committee and executive reporting
- [Cybersecurity & Information Security Risk](https://shinish.github.io/princeton-solutions-site/services/cybersecurity-and-information-security-risk) — Measure your security program against the frameworks your stakeholders expect. Focus: ISO 27001 · NIST CSF.
  - ISO/IEC 27001 readiness, gap assessments and internal ISMS audits
  - NIST CSF and NIST 800-53 control assessments
  - Information security policy, standard and control hierarchy design
  - NY DFS Part 500 cybersecurity compliance reviews
- [Regulatory Compliance & Exam Readiness](https://shinish.github.io/princeton-solutions-site/services/regulatory-compliance-and-exam-readiness) — Prepare for examinations and close findings with evidence regulators accept. Focus: OCC · FFIEC.
  - OCC, FFIEC and CFPB examination readiness
  - Independent validation of MRA and Consent Order remediation
  - Examiner and external auditor request coordination
  - GLBA, GDPR, CCPA and DORA requirement mapping
- [SOX, SOC & Certification Audit Support](https://shinish.github.io/princeton-solutions-site/services/sox-soc-and-certification-audit-support) — Get audit-ready and stay that way, with organized evidence and tracked remediation. Focus: SOX 404 · SSAE 18.
  - IT SOX (302/404) ITGC design, walkthroughs and testing
  - SOC 1 and SOC 2 readiness and evidence repositories
  - Control gap analysis and corrective action tracking to closure
  - Support for private-to-public company control transitions
- [Third-Party & Vendor Risk Management](https://shinish.github.io/princeton-solutions-site/services/third-party-and-vendor-risk-management) — Verify that vendors and offshore delivery centers meet your security, privacy and contract terms. Focus: Global TPRM.
  - TPRM program design, vendor tiering and due-diligence workflows
  - On-site and remote audits of BPO, ITO and managed service providers
  - Security and privacy clause review in vendor and customer contracts
  - SOC report review and complementary user-entity control mapping
- [GRC Program Design & Automation](https://shinish.github.io/princeton-solutions-site/services/grc-program-design-and-automation) — Reduce duplicate testing and give leadership a live view of control health. Focus: RCM · CCM.
  - Rationalized risk and control matrices mapped to a unified framework
  - Three-lines-of-defense testing alignment and methodology
  - GRC platform requirements and workflow design (ServiceNow, ProcessUnity)
  - Continuous control monitoring and Power BI risk dashboards
- [Cloud Governance, Privacy & Due Diligence](https://shinish.github.io/princeton-solutions-site/services/cloud-governance-privacy-and-due-diligence) — Address risk early, before a migration, integration or acquisition closes. Focus: CSA CCM · Azure.
  - Pre-implementation reviews for cloud migrations on Microsoft Azure
  - Cloud control assessments using the CSA Cloud Controls Matrix
  - Data privacy risk evaluations and privacy-by-design reviews
  - Technology and security due diligence for mergers and acquisitions

## Engagement models

- **Assessments** (Fixed scope) — Readiness, gap and maturity assessments with a prioritized remediation roadmap.
- **Audit delivery** (Co-source) — Senior IT audit capacity that plugs into your internal audit plan and methodology.
- **Validation** (Independent) — Independent testing of remediation for regulatory findings, MRAs and audit issues.
- **Advisory** (Retainer) — Ongoing SME support for GRC, security, privacy and AI governance decisions.

## How an engagement runs

1. **Scope** — Agree objectives, criteria, frameworks and stakeholders. Confirm what evidence will satisfy each requirement.
2. **Assess** — Walk through processes, test controls and validate evidence with control owners.
3. **Report** — Deliver risk-rated findings, root causes and practical recommendations in plain language.
4. **Validate** — Track corrective actions and independently confirm remediation through closure.

## Standards and regulations covered

- **Banking & financial regulation**: OCC, FFIEC, CFPB, GLBA, NY DFS Part 500, SWIFT CSP, DORA
- **Financial reporting & attestation**: SOX 302 / 404, SSAE 18 SOC 1, SOC 2, COSO
- **Security & IT governance**: ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27032, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, CIS Controls, COBIT, ITIL, CSA CCM, UCF
- **Privacy**: GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA
- **Artificial intelligence**: ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF

## Industries served

- **Banks and savings institutions** — Federally and state-regulated institutions preparing for examinations.
- **Mortgage servicing and lending** — Servicers, sub-servicers and originators with heavy vendor and data obligations.
- **Fintech and financial services providers** — Firms that must evidence controls to bank partners and customers.
- **BPO, ITO and managed service providers** — Providers preparing for client audits and SOC reports.
- **Healthcare and manufacturing** — Organizations needing SOX, ITGC and application security assurance.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does an engagement actually produce?

Every engagement has a defined deliverable and a senior practitioner accountable for it. Assessments produce a readiness, gap or maturity report with a prioritized remediation roadmap. Audit delivery produces workpapers and findings within your existing methodology. Validation produces independent confirmation that remediation closed the issue. Advisory is ongoing subject-matter support.

### How does an engagement run from start to finish?

Four phases. Scope: agree objectives, criteria, frameworks and stakeholders, and confirm what evidence will satisfy each requirement. Assess: walk through processes, test controls and validate evidence with control owners. Report: deliver risk-rated findings, root causes and practical recommendations in plain language. Validate: track corrective actions and independently confirm remediation through closure.

### Which standards and regulations do you work against?

Banking and financial regulation including OCC, FFIEC, CFPB, GLBA, NY DFS Part 500, SWIFT CSP and DORA. Financial reporting and attestation including SOX 302/404, SSAE 18 SOC 1, SOC 2 and COSO. Security and IT governance including ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27032, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, CIS Controls, COBIT, ITIL, CSA CCM and UCF. Privacy including GDPR, CCPA and HIPAA. Artificial intelligence including ISO/IEC 42001 and the NIST AI RMF.

### Do I have to buy a whole program?

No. Engage one service line for a defined scope, or combine several into an integrated assurance program. Engagements are right-sized for organizations without a large audit or GRC function as well as for established internal audit teams.

### Can you work alongside our existing internal audit team?

Yes. Co-sourced audit delivery provides senior IT audit capacity that plugs into your existing internal audit plan and methodology, rather than replacing it.

### Do you sell or implement the software you assess?

No. We assess and advise. We do not resell software or implementation services, which is what keeps the assessment independent.

### Can you audit our offshore delivery centers?

Yes, on-site and remote. Vendor and delivery-center audits have covered the Americas, Europe and Asia, including India, the Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore and Costa Rica.

### How do we start?

Send a note describing your audit, exam or governance need. We reply within two business days with a proposed scope.
